priorities.title: Correct Manual Comparison Crop generation before Ownership work

priorities.title: Coordinate / extent mismatch between Manual and Owned Render
priorities.recommendation: Documented divergence: Manual uses geometry_envelopes.extent; Owned Render uses T182 computed_render_bbox. Align comparison baseline extent with the reinforcement context under evaluation.

priorities.title: Resume Ownership Engine investigation after GT baseline fix
priorities.recommendation: Once Manual crops are trustworthy (Category A), re-run QA.3.1-style ownership diagnostics. Until then, QA.3.1 Ownership FAIL counts may mix true ownership defects with baseline crop defects.
